HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP — TERMLY EXAM #4
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya.
   B. Say Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya as rumours only.
   D. Explain Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Destroying road signs

3. Which statement about Political developments in independent Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Political developments in independent Africa as rumours only.
   B. Explain Political developments in independent Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Political developments in independent Africa.
   D. Say Political developments in independent Africa never happens in Kenya.

4. Which statement about Internal conflicts in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Internal conflicts in Africa.

   C. Explain Internal conflicts in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Internal conflicts in Africa as rumours only.

5. Which statement about Kenyans Response to Colonialism is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Kenyans Response to Colonialism never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Kenyans Response to Colonialism.
   C. Treat Kenyans Response to Colonialism as rumours only.
   D. Explain Kenyans Response to Colonialism with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. Which statement about Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century.

7. Which statement about Colonial Administration in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Colonial Administration in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Colonial Administration in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Colonial Administration in Africa.
   D. Treat Colonial Administration in Africa as rumours only.

8. Which statement about Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya.
   B. Treat Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya as rumours only.
   C. Explain Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya never happens in Kenya.

9. Which statement about Human Developments in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Human Developments in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Human Developments in Africa as rumours only.
   C. Explain Human Developments in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Human Developments in Africa.

10. Which statement about French Revolutions is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain French Revolutions with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat French Revolutions as rumours only.
   C. Say French Revolutions never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing French Revolutions.

11. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Nakuru
   C. Kisumu
   D. Mombasa

12. Which statement about National Security is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say National Security never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain National Security with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing National Security.
   D. Treat National Security as rumours only.

13. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Name the president
   D. Replace the compass rose

14. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Avoid saving forever

15. Which statement about Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship.
   C. Say Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

16. Which statement about Civilisations in South and Central Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Civilisations in South and Central Africa.
   B. Say Civilisations in South and Central Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Civilisations in South and Central Africa as rumours only.
   D. Explain Civilisations in South and Central Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain International Instruments of Human Rights and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Global diversity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain The 2nd Generation of Industrial revolution and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Conflict, Transformation and Peace and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Digital divide and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Inclusivity and Interdependence and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
